levels.vintage_status: latest retrieved history; no retained historical source vintages
levels.classification_continuity: Current raw official file directly carries current group codes and labels in 2015 and 2026. This is evidence of a current recoded history, not independent verification of an item-level concordance or historical real-time availability.
levels.tax_and_regulation_status: Raw national CPI service groups. No tax-first-round correction or CNB-core/regulated membership flags are supplied.

scope_notes.111: Catering includes restaurants, canteens and school canteens; not a restaurant-only history.
scope_notes.112: Accommodation includes hotels, recreation accommodation, school and university dormitories.
scope_notes.042: Imputed rent / owner housing costs; 2026 basket item is acquisition, reconstruction and maintenance of owner housing.
scope_notes.098: Package holidays; current subgroup 096 is cultural services.

weights.unit: per mille of total national CPI basket
weights.basis_year_relation: Each saved workbook header states constant weights for effective_year - 2.
weights.publication_status: Dates are the existing January detailed CPI release proxy, with February 15 fallback. They are not verified historical publication timestamps for these workbook files.
weights.intraday_note: Existing _basket_available_from normalizes the detail release timestamp to midnight. A strict experiment should retain the release hour (09:00 Prague) when applying an intraday origin clock.
weights.classification_mapping: For current 098, use historical basket 09.6 through 2024 and basket 09.8 in 2026. Strip optional E prefix. Other selected group codes are stable at this level.
weights.not_current_shares: These are base basket weights. Contributions require appropriate prior-month price updating and origin availability; normalizing the five groups does not produce official core-services weights.
